alerts.title: Iran war live: Tankers hit in Hormuz; Trump again says conflict to end soon
alerts.why: Strait of Hormuz tanker attacks threaten massive global oil supply disruptions through a critical crude chokepoint.

itemsSent.title: Iran and US explore diplomacy amid rising threats of war
itemsSent.why: Potential de-escalation of Hormuz tensions eases risk premium on crude oil prices.

itemsSent.title: U.S. refineries have been running at very high rates in 2026
itemsSent.why: High refinery runs above 95% boost product output, which is bearish for refined products (RB/HO) while remaining supportive for crude (CL/BZ) demand.

itemsSent.title: OPEC+ subgroup keeps oil production quotas unchanged for December
itemsSent.why: OPEC+ keeping quotas unchanged for December was fully anticipated by markets, resulting in a neutral price impact.

itemsSent.title: LR Tankers: Freight Squeezes Naphtha Arb
itemsSent.why: Middle East war and Hormuz disruptions squeeze naphtha arbitrage, supporting refined product cracks and Asian blending components.
